board.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup board. Reference the provided xianxia homepage template and recreate a clean component styleboard instead of a full playable screen. Preserve the same art direction: airy sky-blue atmosphere, ivory parchment surfaces, celadon teal accents, aged gold outlines, restrained cloud motifs, misty immortal mountain painting language, elegant Chinese xianxia mobile game UI. Show a curated family of reusable shells only: one top resource pill, one circular icon badge, one large cultivation panel shell, one primary CTA button, one feature card shell, one horizontal event banner shell, one bottom navigation tab shell. No text, no characters, no full page layout, no extra scenery outside the component previews, no watermark.
